sentences.text:
This Criminal Petition Is Filed By The vs Unknown on 9 March,
2022
Author: D.Ramesh

Bench: D.Ramesh
 The Honourable Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No.5219 of 2019
O R D E R:
This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner/accused under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal
Procedure, 1973 seeking to quash the proceedings in Fir No.342 of 2019 on the file of the Ongole
Tal

. The offences alleged are under Sections 420, 272, 273,
188, 328 of IPC and under sections 58, 63 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in similar cases, this Court by virtue of common order in Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and batch, quashed the proceedings against the petitioners therein, by considering that transportation of Pan Masala is not attracted by the offences alleged under Sections 188, 270 and 273 of IPC and Food Safety and Standard Act.
A perusal of the order shows that this Court, by considering that transportation of Gutka, Pan masala does not attract the offences alleged, quashed the proceedings.

4. Hence, following the above said judgment and in terms thereof, the criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner in FIR No.342 of 2019 on the file of the Ongole Taluka Police Station, Prakasam District are hereby quashed.
